name: @pipeworx/mcp-hcup-inpatient-stats

tools.name: condition_hospital_costs
tools.description: National U.S. inpatient hospital discharges and aggregate costs by principal diagnosis (CCSR category) and year, from AHRQ HCUP's published "Most Expensive Conditions by Payer" Statistical Brief series — e.g. heart failure, septicemia/sepsis, acute myocardial infarction, COVID-19, stroke (cerebral infarction). Returns the top-20 most expensive conditions nationally (or filtered to one condition) with discharge counts, aggregate cost, and mean cost per stay. Years available: 2022, 2017 (AHRQ has not published a 2021 edition of this cross-condition table as of 2026-10-21). Optionally filter by expected payer (Medicare, Medicaid, private insurance, self-pay) for 2022.

year.description: Statistical Brief edition year. One of: 2022, 2017. Defaults to 2022 (the most recent AHRQ has published).

payer.description: Expected payer to filter by. Only 2022 has per-payer tables; other years return the all-payer table regardless of this argument.

condition.description: Condition name (e.g. "heart failure", "sepsis", "stroke") or CCSR code (e.g. "CIR019") to filter to. Omit to get the full top-20 table for that year/payer.

tools.name: sepsis_hospital_outcomes
tools.description: National U.S. inpatient hospital length of stay and mean cost per stay for sepsis (principal diagnosis), by patient population and year, 2016-2021, from AHRQ HCUP Statistical Brief #306. This is the only public AHRQ cross-year table found that reports a 2021-specific national figure. Separately reports any-listed-diagnosis sepsis stay counts (a broader population than principal diagnosis) for the years AHRQ printed a figure (2016, 2019, 2021).

period.description: Reporting period. "y2021" is the full-year 2021 estimate (with and without a co-occurring COVID-19 diagnosis combined). Defaults to "y2021".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hcup-inpatient-stats forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hcup-inpatient-stats pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
